JOIN Matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id
WHERE m.season = 'IPL 2025'
  AND d.over_number BETWEEN 7 AND 15
GROUP BY d.bowler_id, p.player_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 18
   AND SUM(d.runs_scored + d.wides + d.noballs) * 1.0 / (COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) / 6.0) < 6;

JOIN Deliveries d ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
WHERE m.season = '2025'
  AND COALESCE(m.city, '') NOT LIKE '%Punjab%'
  AND COALESCE(m.venue, '') NOT LIKE '%Punjab%'
  AND p.player_name LIKE '%Iyer%'
GROUP BY m.match_id, m.match_date, m.venue, m.city
ORDER BY m.match_date, m.match_id;
